g.text: Graph revision AC - mt01: Mould seats x2 at y 250 and y 550: steel backing platen 240 x 180 x 46 with a 170 x 130 cavity; seat frame bolted under the deck (4 x M12 per seat, fasteners.csv item 3)

Graph revision AC - mt01: Water jacket assemblies x2: shell t6 (z 486..602) with 170 x 132 cavity; CW stubs run toward the machine-side manifold; the cooling-water loop is a utility circuit without a graph edge, sized at the task 12 first articles (params.json holds)

Graph revision AC - mt01: Fine-graphite inserts x2, 160 x 120 x 110: hot faces per duty section 3 (X-MAT-22 graphite class); open-top cavity 110 x 70 x 60 (0.462 L, about 3.7 kg Cu class per params.json assumptions)
Graph revision AC - mt01: Bottom-fill riser pass D24 through each insert floor into the cavity floor; the riser head D28 (ps01) seats into this pass
Graph revision AC - mt01: Insert change-out is the unit task 12 work order; general tolerance ISO 2768-m
